messages:
Alex H: sharing a compact mock for the billing pane — accordion per project, token breakdown chips, and a small invoice CTA. thoughts? https://img.redwood/mock/compact-pane.png

Maria L: tighter layout looks promising. accessibility nit: token label contrast is low and the invoice CTA reads too prominent for non-billing users.

Ben T: perf note: rendering 300 project rows with sparklines will be slow. we should virtualize rows and lazy-load sparklines. mobile behavior needs a persistent summary to avoid endless collapsing.

Kim (prod): UX principle: default scope = org for billing admins. for project viewers, show a subtle banner "Viewing project spend" instead of switching scope. prevents accidental invoice downloads.

Sam - Eng: on token numbers, are we showing pre-cache or post-cache values? SDKs use emitted_token_count; backend currently returns billed_tokens. we should clarify the metric label to avoid confusion.

Maria L: suggested copy: "Estimated billed tokens (after caching)" + info tooltip. And change primary CTA to "Export CSV" with a secondary "Invoice (billing only)" to reduce legal implication for general users.

Alex H: agree. pattern: primary = CSV, secondary = Invoice disabled for non-billing users with tooltip explaining permissions.

DesignBot: accessibility check: token chip color #6B6BFF on white = 3.2:1 (fails AA). Suggested #4A47D8 yields 4.8:1.

Maria L: also add delta indicator on the right of each row (e.g., +12% / -8%) because tiny sparklines + number lack context when series jump.

Sam - Eng: delta is fine, but emit it from the API as last_period_delta to avoid client compute. backend change needed.

Ben T: layout variants: (A) dense list with inline tiny sparkline + expand for details, (B) card grid with larger visuals. A scales better for big orgs; B nicer for demos. maybe toggle or auto-select based on org size.

Kim (prod): go with A as default, enable B for marketing/psa via a toggle. timeline: internal preview next Thursday? need design + PM signoff before eng starts.

Maria L: I'll update Figma with contrast fix, delta label, and tooltip copy. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-billing-pane — comments open. :eyes:

Alex H: CSS snippet for the chip if helpful:

```
.token-chip {
  background: #4A47D8;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
```

Ben T: I'll add feature flag feature_billing_compact_pane and do a virtualization spike. invoice button will be present but disabled with a tooltip for non-billing roles.

Sam - Eng: I'll add last_period_delta to billing summary API and ensure contracts document the difference between emitted_tokens and billed_tokens.

DesignBot: checklist: contrast fixed ✅, aria-labels noted ✅, billing-perms CTA pattern referenced ✅

Alex H: action items summarized: Maria iterate mock + Figma, Ben feature flag + perf spike, Sam API change, Kim coordinate preview. I'll schedule review Thu 2pm. :calendar:
